change: Expose fused dotted arithmetic, comparisons and function calls through the Dewy frontend; preserve scalar Dewy division, remainder and power semantics. Support fixed-size inputs and fix the inherited null header write on empty broadcast results.

validation.full: Independent C bootstrap, 5000 checks passed in 179.25s. This preceded the final NaN comparison correction.
validation.final: Previous-core rebuild after the NaN correction: 564 numeric, formatting and hover checks passed in 29.59s.

compile_performance.conclusion: No meaningful compile-time change on tour, Netpong and the compiler; wall time is noisier.

coverage: rational division, signed floor division/remainder, right-associative powers
scalar/vector/multidimensional broadcasting, empty and incompatible shapes
fixed and managed inputs, snapshots and cleanup
left-to-right operand evaluation and callback order
limits: Dotted compound assignment and prefix operators remain unsupported.
GPU execution is not yet validated by these checks.
Existing scalar floating floor division/remainder limits remain.
No general runtime speedup claim from this feature increment.
